params.caption: 🎮 Umamusume becomes a founding partner of the F1 Japanese Grand Prix Cygames' horse-girl gacha hit Umamusume: Pretty Derby has signed on as a founding partner of the 2027 F1 Japanese Grand Prix, the event's top sponsorship tier. Suzuka's famous 130R corner will be renamed "Umamusume 130R" for about a year, though Cygames says the branding won't appear during the race itself. A Cygames booth and a special live music show at Suzuka are also planned. No deal value was disclosed. 🕒 Nov 14, 2026 · 17:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 🏎️ Weird crossover or genius marketing?
